profile.summary: Devine and Gong, Inc. is an Oakland-based consulting firm that works on affordable housing. It offers affordable housing financial consulting, housing development consulting and program development. The firm says it has worked on more than 50 projects in the Greater Bay Area.

review.notes: Exact name match and Oakland location; the firm's own pages confirm affordable housing finance and development consulting, the 50+ project claim and Oakland base, which fits OUSD Measure Y asset management and real property work. I could not independently retrieve the Legistar item, but no conflicting similarly named entity surfaced and the summary is neutral and supported.
